Ada County Clerk’s Office

Slide
Welcome to the Ada County Clerk's Office

If you have ever voted, filed paperwork for a court case, picked up a marriage license or applied for a permit in Ada County, we have helped you. We do our best each and every day to make sure your experiences working with our office go as smoothly and efficiently as possible.

Public parking for the Ada County Courthouse and Ada County Indigent Services Office is located on the east side of the courthouse. Parking is free for the first hour and $1 for each additional hour. You will need to go through security to enter the Ada County Courthouse.
